text_en: The whole congregation of the Israelites set out from Elim; and Israel came to the wilderness of Sin, which is between Elim and Sinai, on the fifteenth day of the second month after they had departed from the land of Egypt.
text_cn: 以色列子民全会众从厄林起程，来到厄林和西乃之间的欣旷野，时在离埃及后第二月第十五日。

text_en: The whole congregation of the Israelites complained against Moses and Aaron in the wilderness.
text_cn: 以色列子民全会众在旷野里都抱怨梅瑟和亚郎。

text_en: The Israelites said to them, “If only we had died by the hand of the Lord in the land of Egypt, when we sat by the fleshpots and ate our fill of bread; for you have brought us out into this wilderness to kill this whole assembly with hunger. ”
text_cn: 以色列子民向他们说：“巴不得我们在埃及国坐在肉锅旁，有食物吃饱的时候，死在上主的手中！你们领我们到这旷野里来，是想叫这全会众饿死啊！”

text_en: Then the Lord said to Moses, “I am going to rain bread from heaven for you, and each day the people shall go out and gather enough for that day. In that way I will test them, whether they will follow my instruction or not.
text_cn: 上主向梅瑟说：“看，我要从天上给你们降下食物，百姓要每天出去收敛当日所需要的，为试探他们是否遵行我的法律。

text_en: On the sixth day, when they prepare what they bring in, it will be twice as much as they gather on other days. ”
text_cn: 但到第六天，他们准备带回来的食物要比每天多一倍。”

text_en: So Moses and Aaron said to all the Israelites, “In the evening you shall know that it was the Lord who brought you out of the land of Egypt,
text_cn: 梅瑟和亚郎对全以色列子民说：“今晚你们要知道，是上主领你们出了埃及国；

text_en: and in the morning you shall see the glory of the Lord , because he has heard your complaining against the Lord . For what are we, that you complain against us? ”
text_cn: 明早你们要看见上主的荣耀，因为你们抱怨上主的话，他已听见了。我们算什么？你们竟抱怨我们！”

text_en: And Moses said, “When the Lord gives you meat to eat in the evening and your fill of bread in the morning, because the Lord has heard the complaining that you utter against him—what are we? Your complaining is not against us but against the Lord . ”
text_cn: 梅瑟又说：“晚上上主要给你们肉吃，早晨你们可以吃饱，因为上主听见了你们抱怨他所说的怨言。我们算什么？你们不是抱怨我们，而是抱怨上主。”

text_en: Then Moses said to Aaron, “Say to the whole congregation of the Israelites, ‘Draw near to the Lord , for he has heard your complaining. ’”
text_cn: 梅瑟向亚郎说：“你向以色列子民全会众说：你们应走到上主前，因为他听见了你们的怨言。”

text_en: And as Aaron spoke to the whole congregation of the Israelites, they looked toward the wilderness, and the glory of the Lord appeared in the cloud.
text_cn: 亚郎正向以色列子民全会众说话的时候，他们转面朝向旷野，看见上主的荣耀显现在云彩中。

text_en: The Lord spoke to Moses and said,
text_cn: 那时上主向梅瑟说：

text_en: “I have heard the complaining of the Israelites; say to them, ‘At twilight you shall eat meat, and in the morning you shall have your fill of bread; then you shall know that I am the Lord your God. ’”
text_cn: “我听见了以色列子民的怨言。你给他们说：黄昏的时候你们要有肉吃，早晨要有食物吃饱，这样你们就知道，我是上主，你们的天主。”

text_en: In the evening quails came up and covered the camp; and in the morning there was a layer of dew around the camp.
text_cn: 到了晚上，有鹌鹑飞来，遮盖了营幕；到了早晨，营幕四周落了一层露水。

text_en: When the layer of dew lifted, there on the surface of the wilderness was a fine flaky substance, as fine as frost on the ground.
text_cn: 露水升化之后，在旷野的地面上，留下稀薄的碎屑，稀薄得好像地上的霜。

text_en: When the Israelites saw it, they said to one another, “What is it? ” For they did not know what it was. Moses said to them, “It is the bread that the Lord has given you to eat.
text_cn: 以色列子民一见，就彼此问说：“这是什么？”原来他们不知道这是什么。梅瑟告诉他们说：“这是上主赐给你们吃的食物。

text_en: This is what the Lord has commanded: ‘Gather as much of it as each of you needs, an omer to a person according to the number of persons, all providing for those in their own tents. ’”
text_cn: 上主曾这样吩咐说：你们应按每人的食量去收敛，按照你们帐幕的人数去拾取，每人一"曷默尔"。

text_en: The Israelites did so, some gathering more, some less.
text_cn: 以色列子民就照样作了；收敛的时候，有的多，有的少，

text_en: But when they measured it with an omer, those who gathered much had nothing over, and those who gathered little had no shortage; they gathered as much as each of them needed.
text_cn: 但他们用"曷默尔"衡量时，那多收的，也没有剩余；那少收的，也没有缺少；各人正按他们的食量收敛了。

text_en: And Moses said to them, “Let no one leave any of it over until morning. ”
text_cn: 梅瑟向他们说：“谁也不准将一些留到早晨。”

text_en: But they did not listen to Moses; some left part of it until morning, and it bred worms and became foul. And Moses was angry with them.
text_cn: 但他们没有听梅瑟的话；有些人把一些留到早晨，但都被虫子咬烂，发生臭味；梅瑟遂向他们发怒。

text_en: Morning by morning they gathered it, as much as each needed; but when the sun grew hot, it melted.
text_cn: 于是他们每天早晨按各人的食量去收敛；太阳一发热，就融化了。

text_en: On the sixth day they gathered twice as much food, two omers apiece. When all the leaders of the congregation came and told Moses,
text_cn: 到了第六天他们收敛了两倍的食物，每人二"曷默尔"；会众的首领来向梅瑟报告此事。

text_en: he said to them, “This is what the Lord has commanded: ‘Tomorrow is a day of solemn rest, a holy sabbath to the Lord ; bake what you want to bake and boil what you want to boil, and all that is left over put aside to be kept until morning. ’”
text_cn: 梅瑟向他们说：“上主曾这样吩咐说：明天是安息日，是祝圣于上主的安息圣日；你们要烤的，就烤吧！要煮的，就煮吧！凡吃了剩下的，应保留到次日。”

text_en: So they put it aside until morning, as Moses commanded them; and it did not become foul, and there were no worms in it.
text_cn: 他们就照梅瑟所吩咐的，把吃了剩下的，留到次日也没有发臭，也没有虫咬。

text_en: Moses said, “Eat it today, for today is a sabbath to the Lord ; today you will not find it in the field.
text_cn: 梅瑟说道：“今天吃这些吧！因为今天是敬上主的安息日，今天在野外什么也找不到。

text_en: Six days you shall gather it; but on the seventh day, which is a sabbath, there will be none. ”
text_cn: 六天你们可去收敛，但第七天是安息日，什么也没有。”

text_en: On the seventh day some of the people went out to gather, and they found none.
text_cn: 到了第七天，百姓中有人去收敛，但什么也没有找到。

text_en: The Lord said to Moses, “How long will you refuse to keep my commandments and instructions?
text_cn: 上主向梅瑟说：“你们不守我的命令和我的法律要到何时呢？

text_en: See! The Lord has given you the sabbath, therefore on the sixth day he gives you food for two days; each of you stay where you are; do not leave your place on the seventh day. ”
text_cn: 看上主给你们立了安息日，为此到第六天他给你们两天的食物；到第七天各人都应留在家内，不准任何人离开自己的地方。”

text_en: So the people rested on the seventh day.
text_cn: 这样百姓在第七天守了安息日。

text_en: The house of Israel called it manna; it was like coriander seed, white, and the taste of it was like wafers made with honey.
text_cn: 以色列家给这食物取名叫"玛纳"。它像胡荽（suī）的种子那样白，滋味好似蜜饼。

text_en: Moses said, “This is what the Lord has commanded: ‘Let an omer of it be kept throughout your generations, in order that they may see the food with which I fed you in the wilderness, when I brought you out of the land of Egypt. ’”
text_cn: 梅瑟说：“上主这样吩咐说：装满一‘曷默尔’玛纳，留给你们的后代子孙，为使他们能看到我领你们出离埃及国时，在旷野里养活你们的食物。”

text_en: And Moses said to Aaron, “Take a jar, and put an omer of manna in it, and place it before the Lord , to be kept throughout your generations. ”
text_cn: 梅瑟向亚郎说：“拿一个罐子，装满一‘曷默尔’玛纳，放在上主面前，留给你们的后代子孙。”

text_en: As the Lord commanded Moses, so Aaron placed it before the covenant, for safekeeping.
text_cn: 亚郎就照上主吩咐梅瑟的话，将玛纳放在约版前面，保留起来。

text_en: The Israelites ate manna forty years, until they came to a habitable land; they ate manna, until they came to the border of the land of Canaan.
text_cn: 以色列子民吃玛纳四十年之久，直到进入有人居住的地方为止；他们吃玛纳，直到进入客纳罕地的边界。

text_en: An omer is a tenth of an ephah.
text_cn: 一"曷默尔"是一"厄法”的十分之一。
